_comment: AdMob monetization config for War of Love (loaded by AdsService / autoload 'Ads'). use_test_ads=true keeps Google's OFFICIAL TEST ad unit ids in play — NEVER ship with test ids, NEVER test with production ids. The 'prod' fields are empty placeholders: fill them from the AdMob console before a real release and flip use_test_ads to false. Ad unit ids are not secrets; the AdMob app id also goes in the Android export/manifest metadata at integration time. The game stays fully playable with NO ads — every placement degrades to its normal non-ad behaviour when ads are unavailable/offline.
